title: The customs quay
brief: A working seventeenth-century Caribbean port: limewashed ochre warehouses, shuttered arcades, terracotta roofs, palms, heavy mooring timbers and warm brass lamps beside the broad timber quay.

title: The broken cargo jetty
brief: Three storm-broken boardwalk spans on visibly rooted barnacled piles, a timber crane and suspended pallet, barrel stacks, a narrow optional salvage spar and small moored cargo lighters.

title: Beneath the fort
brief: A weathered limestone fort crowns the rocky headland; a narrow boardwalk turns beneath it into a timber-braced smugglers sea gate. Sunset over the open sea gives way to cool cave shade.

title: The smugglers fissure
brief: An old mining passage cut in wet layered limestone, crooked oak braces, bronze lanterns, rope and supply clutter. A narrow tidal fissure interrupts the worn trail; the far bank remains clearly visible.

title: The hidden crystal grotto
brief: An intimate secret alcove with restrained turquoise mineral seams, an abandoned expedition cache, damp stone shelves and old lantern glow. Curious Goonies treasure-hunt atmosphere.

title: The moonpool and the Drowned Crown
brief: The huge broken royal galleon is revealed inside a cathedral-sized limestone sea cavern. Three ragged ivory sails, ornate stern, worn hull strakes, turquoise water, pale shafts through roof fissures. A supported salvage gangway leads onto the ship.

title: The abandoned afterdeck
brief: Human-scale oak deck planks, ship cannon, coiled rope, bronze lanterns, broken carved bulwarks and heavy rigging. Warm wood against the cool cavern; clear central traversal around the mast.

title: The captain's last chart
brief: An intimate raised captain's chart cabin: aged carved oak, tarnished gilding, leaded amber stern windows, parchment sea chart and compass on a heavy table, a small treasure chest and warm hanging lanterns.

title: Through the broken hull
brief: Splintered giant ship ribs and a descending broken hatch lead into the torn keel, turquoise water below. A narrow grounded timber crossing, distant lit cargo hold, high fallen mast and dangling anchor make multiple paths visually legible.

title: Below the waterline
brief: The cavernous cargo hold with heavy curved ribs, overhead oak deck beams, stacked barrels and sea chests, warm lamps and rippling turquoise reflected light. A broad readable floor leads toward the bow hatch ramp.

title: The secret powder cache
brief: A hidden stone-and-timber powder cache visible through the shattered port hull, old sealed barrels, a small open treasure chest, a glowing turquoise jewel and subtle gold glints in dark rock.

title: The escape bridge
brief: A frayed but structurally anchored rope-and-plank escape bridge stretches from the broken galleon's bow to a rocky treasure tunnel. One clearly visible broken span, sagging cables, massive cave depth and moonlit water below.

title: The king's ransom
brief: The final treasure vault: timeworn carved stone, a broad rising dais, rich but carefully grouped gold heaps, jewelled treasure chests, warm lanterns, an old royal skull-and-crown portal and a bright distant sea exit framing the finish.
